sql:
SELECT DISTINCT s.symbol_id
FROM code.symbols s
JOIN code.class_bases cb ON s.symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id
WHERE cb.base_name = 'JupyterMixin'
  AND s.symbol_id NOT IN (
    SELECT s2.symbol_id
    FROM code.symbols s2
    WHERE s2.qualname LIKE '%__rich_measure__%'
